name: Utility Corridor
narrativeOnEnter: A narrow service corridor behind the main lab. Exposed conduits, cable runs, the smell of burnt insulation. A power junction at the far end is still partially alive — flickering. The bypass chips for the laser grid are stored here.

action.text:
HIGH VOLTAGE — AUTHORISED PERSONNEL ONLY

Power Junction PJ-7
Emergency bypass chips stored in lower compartment.
For use only in authorised grid bypass procedures.

If the Emergency Exit Corridor laser grid is active:
Insert bypass chip into the laser control port to initiate manual override sequence.

DO NOT reset junction sequence without proper PPE.

A large scorch mark spreads up from a melted cable junction. The fire suppression system cut in at some point — faint white residue on the floor below.

Scratched into the soot with something sharp:

'K WAS HERE'

And below it, barely visible:

'I tried to warn them. They didn't listen.
If you find this — finish what I started.'

hotspots.label: Bypass Chip Compartment
hotspots.lockedMessage: The compartment is locked — stabilise the junction frequency above first.
